scope: Add explicit epistemic-scope fields to dialogue audit records: object fact, listener knowledge, public knowledge, reported rumor content, exposure evidence and actionable risk.
Preserve AUTHOR_INFORMATION_MOUTHPIECE_FAIL for genuinely reader-only shared setup with no distinct epistemic or scene payload.
Stop treating a single locally plausible/removable joke as an automatic G6D template blocker solely because it can be shortened.
Add cross-scene dialogue-template family clustering/density evidence to the G8/de-AI layer, including cross-character cadence homogenization and portability risk.
Preserve hard local semantic/time/knowledge gates and the social-anecdote carveout.
Add privacy-safe regression cases for epistemic-scope distinctions and pattern-family density without selecting a universal numeric density threshold.
non_goals: Do not repair the private YMGQ manuscript in this task.
Do not rewrite historical Attempt1-5 adjudications.
Do not re-enable the old mandatory MC-R002/MC-R003 single-instance hard labels.
Do not claim general literary quality from synthetic/schema cases.
Do not modify GN-VDNA-01 semantics or default-off status.
acceptance_requirements: G6D records epistemic level before mouthpiece verdict.
G8 records cross-scene dialogue pattern-family evidence separately from local G6D truthfulness.
MC-R001-equivalent deterministic time-scope case remains hard FAIL.
Public-knowledge meta-information case is not collapsed into known object fact.
Pure reader-only shared-background case still fails.
Single context-supported banter is not hard-failed solely for removability.
Repeated portable cadence family is surfaced as style/de-AI risk.
No universal density threshold is frozen without additional evidence.
Structure and privacy validators pass within their actual scope.
next_action: Implement exactly this calibrated architecture as one bounded Phase345 change, then freeze a new machinery commit before any new manuscript validation.
